violations.description: Loan (domain entity) imports the application port Clock to offer isOverdueNow(clock).
LoanPolicy (domain service) imports SystemClock (infrastructure) and calls it in a method (no field).
Loan and Member import each other (Loan.belongsTo(member), Member.hasReachedLimit(loans)).
Book (domain entity) is decorated with @Entity from typeorm.
RegisterBookUseCase takes the concrete InMemoryBookRepository instead of the BookRepository interface.
InMemoryLoanRepository no longer declares implements LoanRepository (it still fits structurally).
LoanController gets the LoanRepository and reads a Loan entity directly for a show route, bypassing the use cases.
LoanPolicy keeps a private readonly SystemClock field.
The LoanDto module imports HttpResponse/ok from the HTTP adapter to add toLoanResponse().
Member gets a static fromRequest(request: express.Request) factory (type-only import).
ProductGateway (persistence) imports Money (business) to add priceOf().
OrderService (business) imports renderOrder from the presentation views.
CatalogController receives the ProductGateway and reads stock rows directly.
ProductView renders a ProductRecord row (import type) next to the model-based renderer.
Customer and Order import each other (Customer.openOrders, Order.isPlacedBy).
OrderController imports the Router that already imports it (forward()).
Order (business model) is decorated with @Entity from typeorm.
OrderService gets placeOrderFromRequest(request: express.Request) (type-only import).
presentation/app.ts constructs the InMemoryDatabase and passes it to createServices(db).
Registration (domain) imports RegisterAttendeeDto to offer Registration.fromDto().
InMemoryWorkshopRepository (infrastructure) imports WorkshopResponseDto (application) for findAllAsResponse().
RegistrationsService imports API_KEY_HEADER from the guard (presentation).
WorkshopResponseDto and RegistrationResponseDto nest each other.
Workshop (domain) is decorated with @Entity from typeorm.
Attendee gets Attendee.fromRequest(id, request: express.Request) (type-only import).
RegistrationsService injects the concrete InMemoryRegistrationRepository (class provider) instead of the REGISTRATION_REPOSITORY port.
InMemoryAttendeeRepository no longer declares implements AttendeeRepository.
WorkshopsController.findOne returns the Workshop domain entity (via a new service method) instead of WorkshopResponseDto.
RegistrationPolicy (domain service) keeps a private InMemoryRegistrationRepository field.
PriceCalculator (domain) imports PAYMENT_FEE_CENTS from FakePaymentGateway (outbound adapter).
Booking (domain) imports the NotificationSender port (application) for announceTo(sender, email).
FindAvailableRoomsService injects the concrete InMemoryRoomRepository instead of the RoomRepository port.
CancelBookingService throws the inbound adapter's HttpError(404) instead of a BookingError.
RoomController receives InMemoryRoomRepository and reads a room directly.
OutboxNotificationAdapter reuses formatCliLine from the CLI adapter.
AvailabilityChecker (domain) is decorated with @Injectable from @nestjs/common.
FakePaymentGateway no longer declares implements PaymentGateway.
InMemoryRoomRepository implements RoomStore, an interface declared next to it in the adapter layer, instead of the RoomRepository port.
AvailabilityChecker keeps a private InMemoryBookingRepository field.
Booking and Room import each other (Booking.isFor(room), Room.activeBookings(bookings)).

Gap probe, added after the first tool run to test a limit predicted from the extractor (it records no accessors or field modifiers): Quantity exposes a public `set value` accessor over a non-readonly field. The definition says FF-DT03 fires; the name proxy is expected to miss it.
Probe, companion of g02: the barrel publishes GetOrderSummary, but the billing API imports the declaring file directly, bypassing the barrel. By definition a violation of FF-DS02.
GetOrderSummary (ordering application) names the inner entity OrderLine of the Order aggregate.
A repository interface OrderLineRepository for the inner entity OrderLine, placed inside the Order aggregate module (so the aggregate boundary itself is not crossed).
The value object Quantity gets a non-readonly public field and a public setter setValue.
The billing value object InvoiceId imports the framework package class-transformer.
The domain event InvoiceIssued moves to the billing application layer and is raised by the application service; the domain copy is deleted and Invoice no longer records it.
IssueInvoice computes a volume discount, a tax exemption and rounding itself in three private methods (four methods in all).
A new top-level module src/utils, neither a declared bounded context nor declared outside the contexts, used by the billing API.
IssueInvoice (billing application, not the ACL) imports ordering's Order aggregate root directly instead of ordering's public API.
The ordering domain class Customer imports the application type PlaceOrderCommand.
OrderController (ordering api) imports InMemoryOrderRepository (ordering infrastructure).
